commit.subject: fix: reject project-local Windows PATH aliases

security_review.initial_finding: A relative PATH entry such as '.', a project directory named explicitly in PATH, or an external junction resolving into the project could still select a project-local executable.
additional_aliases_reviewed: mapped drives resolving to UNC shares
remediation: Accept only ordinary drive-qualified Windows PATH entries.
Canonicalize the project root and every candidate directory before executable lookup.
Require canonical paths to remain ordinary drive-qualified paths.
Reject lexical or canonical directories equal to or inside the project.
Return the canonical directory so lookup cannot traverse a rejected alias.
Fail closed for project roots on UNC or device namespaces.
security_review.independent_final_review: Two independent read-only reviews found no remaining P1 or P2 issue.
